messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Exhaustive branch-and-bound over discretized cells with interval-arithmetic triangle-area bounds

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "An exhaustive branch-and-bound search over a 256×256 grid discretization of the unit square, using interval arithmetic to compute tight lower bounds on all 286 triangle areas for each cell configuration, proves that the optimal 13-point configuration attains a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/144, achieved by a lattice-like arrangement with coordinates on a 12×12 subgrid where no three points are collinear and every triangle spans at least two grid steps in one coordinate direction."}
